# Magai

> A comprehensive help and support platform providing guides, FAQs, and resources for users.

Magai's help center serves as the central resource hub for users seeking assistance with product features, subscription management, and troubleshooting. The platform is supported by team members including Precious, Dustin, and Paul.

## Key Topics

- Help Center
- FAQ
- Getting Started
- Video Tutorials
- Subscription Management
- Troubleshooting
- Affiliate Program
- User Guide

## Support & Documentation

- [Home | Magai Help Center](https://help.magai.co): Magai Help Center with FAQs, guides, troubleshooting and subscription management
